purpose: Use already-held historical PRE-only data to build a fail-closed candidate empirical envelope for Digital Twin realism, without promoting the source to admitted real-world truth and without training/promoting a sporting model.
owner_direction: Prioritize a reality-calibrated virtual keirin world and large simulation now; use future real PRE as calibration sensors rather than blocking research waiting for live races.

already_observed_before_lock: PRE_STRUCTURED and PRE_PROVENANCE each contain 2000 records
collection report says PASS_COMPLETE and result_accessed=false, payout_accessed=false, market_odds_used=false, external_prediction_fields_used=false
provenance source is KDreams historical race-detail pages
source records are labeled STAGED_UNPROVEN_HISTORICAL_PRE, availability proof NOT_YET_PROVEN_FOR_HISTORICAL_REPLAY, training_eligibility=false
universe date range observed as 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-10 and 32 venue codes
schema sample exposed class, score, style, B, H/S-like S, nige, makuri, sashi, mark and historical PRE rates/counts

stability.compare: five-fold aggregate spread; large drift prevents single-point calibration

allowed: candidate ranges for observable PRE marginals
falsification of obviously unrealistic synthetic PRE
not_allowed: claim that KDreams-derived frequencies are the keirin population truth
direct sporting model training from these rows
line-shape calibration because line membership is not present in this artifact
bank/wind effect calibration from this artifact

planned_generator_strategy.anti_circularity: Candidate models C0/C1/N1 do not define the PRE generator calibration targets.

realism_test_plan.stage_3: real-vs-twin discriminator only against this staged candidate source, explicitly labeled CANDIDATE_SOURCE_DISCRIMINATOR
realism_test_plan.success_semantics: Passing means harder to distinguish from the staged PRE candidate distribution, not proof of real-world equivalence.
